name: Pork Chop & Rice Casserole
description: A casserole featuring pork chops, rice, and vegetables baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a 9x13 inch casserole pan with cooking spray.
Put raw rice in the casserole pan.
Melt butter or margarine and sauté green onions and garlic in a frying pan, then mix with rice.
Brown pork chops on both sides and place evenly on top of the rice mixture.
Place a slice of tomato, onion, and green pepper on top of each pork chop.
Pour beef broth over the casserole and cover with foil.
Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1/2 hours until the liquid is absorbed.

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Meat and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole with ground beef, sliced potatoes, and corn, topped with a savory gravy.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer sliced potatoes in an 8L casserole dish.
Mix the gravy mix with 1 cup water and pour over the potatoes. Add remaining water.
Top with corn and the browned meat mixture.
Cover and cook at 350°F for 50 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meat casserole, potato and corn dish, gravy topping

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Rosemary Shipwreck Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, and a tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine beef, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Place potatoes in the bottom of a greased 2-quart casserole dish.
Top potatoes with chopped onion.
Cover onion layer with the beef mixture.
Spoon pork and beans over the beef layer.
Pour tomato soup over the pork and beans.
Cover the casserole and bake for 1 hour or until done.

_similar.keywords: shipwreck casserole, ground beef, potato casserole

_similar.name: Mock Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: A casserole-style dish mimicking cabbage rolls, featuring a savory ground beef and rice mixture layered over shredded cabbage and topped with cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown hamburger with chopped onion, salt, pepper, mushrooms, seasoning salt, onion powder, and garlic salt in a skillet.
Add rice, tomatoes, and soup to the browned hamburger mixture; mix well.
Shred cabbage and place in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Place the hamburger mixture on top of the cabbage layer.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top, cover, and return to oven for an additional 15 to 30 minutes, or until cabbage is cooked and cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: mock cabbage rolls, casserole, cheesy cabbage
